entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I need to make a return. I think. I'm just so confused by the whole process on your website.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number to start?
Yes, it's Mark Peterson, order number VF789021.
Thank you, Mark. I see your order here for the Aero Road Helmet. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference?

Oh, it's nothing broken. It's just... the color. It looked different online and I don't like it. I know it's been a little while, but the box is unopened. I just got so overwhelmed with everything, I didn't know what to do. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Mark. I understand. Getting the right color is important. Let me just check the policy for you. I see the order was delivered 36 days ago.
Is that bad? I'm sorry, I just... I didn't know.
Not at all. Let's see... okay, according to our knowledge base, standard items like this helmet are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So you are well within the window.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. So I can send it back?

Absolutely. Your safety is our top priority, and we want to ensure you have a helmet you'll be happy to wear. I've just initiated the return process and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email on file. You can just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office.
Wow, that's it? Thank you so much, Diana. You've made this so easy.
You're very welcome, Mark. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
